heading.zh-Hant: 出身、求學與社民黨早年
heading.en: Birth, schooling and early Social Democratic career

body.zh-Hant: 赫爾曼·米勒（Hermann Müller）1876年5月18日生於曼海姆。他在曼海姆與德勒斯登就讀實科中學，之後因家境困難改赴法蘭克福接受商業學徒訓練。1893年加入德國社會民主黨（SPD）；1899年起在格爾利茨的社民黨報編輯部工作，1903至1906年任該市議員（Stadtverordneter）。
body.en: Hermann Müller was born in Mannheim on 18 May 1876. He attended the Realgymnasium in Mannheim and Dresden, then had to take up a commercial apprenticeship in Frankfurt for lack of means. He joined the Social Democratic Party (SPD) in 1893; from 1899 he worked on the editorial staff of a Social Democratic paper in Görlitz, and he was a city councillor (Stadtverordneter) there in 1903–06.

heading.zh-Hant: 黨務幹部、戰時與革命時期
heading.en: Party functionary, the war and the revolution

body.zh-Hant: 1906年在奧古斯特·倍倍爾（August Bebel）提議下，米勒當選社民黨黨執行委員會（Parteivorstand）成員，立場偏中間派，並因語言能力主要負責黨的國際聯繫。1914年大戰前夕他前往法國，與法國社會黨人商議共同立場，但沒有達成協議。1916年他經補選首次進入帝國議會，1918年成為柏林工人與士兵代表會執行委員會（Vollzugsrat）成員。
body.en: In 1906, on the proposal of August Bebel, Müller was elected to the SPD executive (Parteivorstand), taking a centrist position and, thanks to his languages, handling mainly the party's international contacts. On the eve of the First World War in 1914 he travelled to France to agree a common stance with the French socialists, but no agreement was reached. He first entered the Reichstag in 1916 through a by-election, and in 1918 became a member of the executive council (Vollzugsrat) of the Greater Berlin workers' and soldiers' councils.

heading.zh-Hant: 國民議會、外交部長與總理
heading.en: National Assembly, Foreign Minister and Chancellor

body.zh-Hant: 1919年1月19日米勒當選威瑪國民議會議員；艾伯特出任帝國總統後，米勒與奧托·韋爾斯（Otto Wels）共同當選社民黨主席。據NDB，他在鮑爾內閣（1919年6月21日至1920年3月26日）出任帝國外交部長，並簽署凡爾賽條約。卡普—呂特維茨政變後他接受組閣，據NDB，該內閣存續於1920年3月27日至6月8日。
body.en: On 19 January 1919 Müller was elected to the National Assembly; after Ebert became Reich President, Müller and Otto Wels were jointly elected SPD chairmen. According to the NDB he served as Reich Foreign Minister in the Bauer cabinet (21 June 1919 to 26 March 1920) and signed the Treaty of Versailles. After the Kapp–Lüttwitz Putsch he accepted the task of forming a government; the NDB gives that cabinet's span as 27 March to 8 June 1920.

heading.zh-Hant: 議會黨團主席與國際活動
heading.en: Parliamentary party leader and international work

body.zh-Hant: 1920年6月6日威瑪聯盟在國會選舉中落敗，米勒辭去總理職務；他以弗蘭肯選區議員身分進入國會，改姓米勒—弗蘭肯（Müller-Franken），並出任社民黨國會黨團主席。NDB載其1920至1928年任黨團主席。1921年他在黨代表大會上提案，使社民黨得以在國家與邦層級與德意志人民黨（DVP）結成聯合政府；1923年他當選社會主義工人國際（SAI）執行委員會。
body.en: After the Weimar parties lost the Reichstag election, Müller resigned as Chancellor on 6 June 1920; he entered the Reichstag as a deputy for the Franconia constituency, took the double name Müller-Franken and became chairman of the SPD Reichstag group. The NDB gives his group chairmanship as 1920–28. In 1921 he moved a motion at the party congress allowing coalitions with the German People's Party (DVP) at Reich and state level, and in 1923 he was elected to the executive of the Labour and Socialist International (SAI).

body.zh-Hant: 1928年6月28日，在社民黨於5月20日的選舉獲勝後，米勒組成由社民黨、人民黨、中央黨與民主黨參加的大聯合政府。1930年3月12日國會通過楊格計畫，被視為重大外交成就；3月27日他因社民黨黨團拒絕支持失業保險妥協案而辭職。1930年9月他呼籲社民黨支持布呂寧政府；1931年3月20日他在柏林去世。
body.en: On 28 June 1928, after the SPD's success in the election of 20 May, Müller formed a "grand coalition" of the SPD, DVP, Centre and DDP. On 12 March 1930 the Reichstag adopted the Young Plan, an important foreign-policy success; on 27 March he resigned because the SPD group refused to back a compromise on unemployment insurance. In September 1930 he called on the Social Democrats to support the Brüning government; he died in Berlin on 20 March 1931.
